items.ex_en: I'm sorry, I don't understand.

items.en: I didn't understand. / I didn't catch that.
items.ex_en: Sorry, I didn't catch that.
items.notes: Italians use the past tense here much more than English does.

items.ex: Scusi, può ripetere il nome, per favore?
items.ex_en: Excuse me, can you repeat the name, please?
I didn't get it, can you say it again?
Excuse me, more slowly, please.
items.notes: Also common: più piano, per favore.

items.ex_en: Excuse me, can you speak more slowly?
items.notes: Informal: Puoi parlare più lentamente?

items.ex_en: Excuse me, do you speak English? — A little.
Do you speak English? — Yes, pretty well.

items.ex: Parlo un po' d'italiano, ma non molto.
items.ex_en: I speak a little Italian, but not much.
items.notes: po' takes an apostrophe (it's short for poco), not an accent.

items.ex: Sto imparando l'italiano da due mesi.
items.ex_en: I've been learning Italian for two months.

items.ex: Mi scusi, non parlo bene l'italiano.
items.ex_en: Sorry, I don't speak Italian well.

items.en: How do you say … in Italian?
items.ex: Come si dice 'receipt' in italiano? — Scontrino.
items.ex_en: How do you say 'receipt' in Italian? — Scontrino.
What does 'magari' mean?
items.notes: Also: Che cosa vuol dire…? / Cosa significa…?

items.ex_en: What does 'boh' mean?
That's thirty euros. — Sorry?
items.notes: Informal: Come, scusa? or just Come?

items.ex: Scusi, non ho sentito. Come ha detto?
items.ex_en: Sorry, I didn't hear. What did you say?
items.notes: Informal: Scusa, non ho sentito. Come hai detto?

items.ex: Scusi, ancora una volta, per favore.
items.ex_en: Sorry, one more time, please.

items.en: Can you write it down, please? (formal)
items.ex: Non ho capito il nome. Può scriverlo, per favore?
items.ex_en: I didn't get the name. Can you write it down, please?
items.notes: Also: Me lo può scrivere? Informal: Puoi scriverlo?

items.en: How do you spell it? / How is it written?
items.ex_en: Excuse me, how do you spell it?
Oh, got it! Thanks.
items.notes: Literally 'I understood' — the normal way to say 'I see / got it'.

items.ex_en: Just a moment, please. I'm coming!

items.ex: Aspetti un momento, cerco il biglietto.
items.ex_en: Wait a moment, I'm looking for my ticket.

items.ex: Aspetta un attimo, non trovo le chiavi.
items.ex_en: Wait a sec, I can't find the keys.
Excuse me, can you help me?
items.notes: Also: Può aiutarmi?

items.ex: Mi puoi aiutare con la valigia?
items.ex_en: Can you help me with the suitcase?

items.ex: Scusi, dov'è il bagno? — In fondo a destra.
items.ex_en: Excuse me, where's the bathroom? — At the end, on the right.
I'd like some information, please.
items.notes: The polite, standard way to ask for things — softer than voglio (I want).

items.ex_en: Excuse me, I have a question.

items.ex: Che cos'è questo? — È un arancino.
items.ex_en: What is this? — It's an arancino (fried rice ball).
items.notes: Shorter: Cos'è?
items.flag: Regional: arancino (m.) in Catania and eastern Sicily, arancina (f.) in Palermo; both are correct.

items.ex: Come si chiama questo in italiano?
items.ex_en: What's this called in Italian?
What do you recommend today?
items.notes: Informal: Cosa mi consigli?

items.ex_en: May I? — Yes, go ahead!
I'm looking for this address.
I'm fine, and you?
Fine, thanks. And you?

items.ex: Sono di New York. — Davvero? Che bello!
items.ex_en: I'm from New York. — Really? How nice!
I'm tired. — Me too!
I'm not hungry. — Me neither.
items.notes: Also: Nemmeno io.

items.ex: È tardi! — Lo so, lo so.
items.ex_en: It's late! — I know, I know.
I'm sorry, I don't have time.
items.notes: For real regret or bad news; for 'excuse me' use scusi / scusa.

items.ex: Il vino rosso è finito. — Non importa.
items.ex_en: We're out of red wine. — It doesn't matter.
Sorry I'm late! — No problem.
items.notes: Also: Non c'è problema.

items.ex_en: Thanks for the help, that's very kind of you!
items.notes: Also: Grazie per l'aiuto.

items.ex_en: Thank you, that's very kind of you.
items.notes: Informal: Sei molto gentile.

items.ex: Scusi, c'è un problema con il conto.
items.ex_en: Excuse me, there's a problem with the check.
Help! Call an ambulance!
Excuse me, I need help.
Call the police, please!
items.notes: Informal: Chiama la polizia! Emergency number in Italy and the EU: 112.

items.ex: Scusi, mi sono perso. Dov'è il centro?
items.ex_en: Excuse me, I'm lost. Where's downtown?
items.notes: A woman says: Mi sono persa.

items.ex: Domani alle otto. Capito? — Sì, capito!
items.ex_en: Tomorrow at eight. Got it? — Yes, got it!

items.en: Is there anyone who speaks English?
items.ex: Scusi, c'è qualcuno che parla inglese?
items.ex_en: Excuse me, is there anyone who speaks English?
How do you pronounce this word?

items.ex: Scusi, può parlare più forte? C'è rumore.
items.ex_en: Sorry, can you speak up? It's noisy.

items.it: Può dirlo in un altro modo?
items.en: Can you say it another way? (formal)
items.ex: Non ho capito. Può dirlo in un altro modo?
items.ex_en: I didn't understand. Can you say it another way?

items.en: What do you mean? / In what way?
items.ex: È un posto particolare. — In che senso?
items.ex_en: It's an unusual place. — What do you mean?
I'll be there soon. — Meaning? When?

items.en: I don't know how to say it.
items.ex: Vorrei… non so come si dice…
items.ex_en: I'd like… I don't know how to say it…

items.ex: Potrebbe chiamare un taxi, per favore?
items.ex_en: Could you call a taxi, please?
items.notes: Conditional of potere; more polite than può. Informal: potresti…?

items.en: Could you tell me…? (formal, very polite)
items.ex: Mi saprebbe dire dov'è la stazione?
items.ex_en: Could you tell me where the station is?
items.notes: Informal: Mi sapresti dire…?

items.ex_en: Would it be possible to change rooms?

items.en: Can one…? / Is it OK to…?
items.ex_en: Excuse me, can we go in?

items.ex: Scusi il disturbo, ha un minuto?
items.ex_en: Sorry to bother you, do you have a minute?

items.en: Excuse me, can I get by? (formal)
items.ex_en: Excuse me, can I get by? I'm getting off here.
items.notes: Also just: Permesso!

items.ex_en: Sorry! — No worries.

items.ex: Non si preoccupi, va bene così.
items.ex_en: Don't worry, it's fine like this.
Don't worry, I'll pay.
items.notes: Also: Non preoccuparti.

items.en: I made a mistake. / My mistake.
items.ex_en: Sorry, wrong number.
I'm not sure, maybe tomorrow.
items.notes: A woman says: Non sono sicura.

items.ex_en: How long does it take? — It depends.
Please, it's an emergency!
Help, I lost my passport!

items.ex: Mi hanno rubato il portafoglio sul tram.
items.ex_en: Someone stole my wallet on the streetcar.
What happened? — Nothing, everything's fine.
items.notes: Also: Che cosa è successo?

items.ex_en: Watch out! There's a step.
items.notes: Also: Attento! / Attenta! (to a man / a woman).

items.ex_en: That's enough, thanks!
That's enough, leave me alone!
items.notes: Informal: Lasciami in pace!
